data.current_description: Create a new booking page. Requires the `booking_pages:write` scope. Every field of the public API is a flag: hours (--availability/--date-overrides, or --schedule-id to reuse a library schedule), team pages (--organization-id with --scheduling-type/--hosts), limits, privacy, seats, recurrence and reminders. Nested fields (--availability, --date-overrides, --custom-questions, --duration-options, --widgets, --hosts, --reminder-configs) take JSON. Availability calendars are not settable on create — a new page uses the account-wide conflict-check selection until you narrow it with an update.
data.description_suggestion: Create a new booking page (event type with public booking link). Requires the `booking_pages:write` scope. Nested fields like availability, custom-questions, duration-options, widgets, and reminder-configs accept JSON objects. Note: Availability calendars default to account-wide conflict-check settings and can be customized via subsequent updates.
